# Western Wilson

> Personal site of Western Wilson, a Māori cloud and platform engineer from Aotearoa New Zealand, based in Amsterdam and working at Sensys Gatso Group. Over five years in DevOps and infrastructure: Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS and Google Cloud, observability and security controls. Writes reflections on platform engineering, AI coding agents, books and life. A generalist and tinkerer chasing threads. Content is personal and opinionated, not a corporate publication.

## Pages

- [About](/about/): Who Western is, what he works on, and how to get in touch
- [Now](/now/): What Western is currently focused on
- [Reflections](/reflections/): Written pieces on software, engineering, and broader observations
- [Books](/books/): Reading log and notes
- [Techstack](/techstack/): Tools and technologies Western uses
